bundle.shortDescription: Uninstall apps and wipe every trace they leave
bundle.longDescription: UWiper runs an app's own uninstaller, then finds what it left behind – folders, registry keys, services, scheduled tasks, startup entries and shortcuts – and moves what you pick to quarantine, ready to restore. It also cleans caches and is fully portable.
